```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggrepel)
library(egg)
Idents(dcSubReg) <- "Phase"
DimPlot(dcSubReg, split.by = 'HTO_maxID')

plot(reducedDim(sds), col = cell_colors_clust, pch = 16, cex = 0.2)
lines(sds, lwd = 2, type = 'lineages', col = 'black', cex = 1.2)

plot(reducedDim(sds), col = cell_colors_clust, pch = 16, cex = 0.2)
lines(sds, lwd = 2, col = 'black')

ggplot(SRclu1Mkr, aes(x=avg_logFC, y=-log10(p_val_adj), label=row.names(SRclu1Mkr))) + geom_point(size = 1) +
      geom_label_repel(data=  SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,], aes(label = row.names(SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,])),
                      box.padding = unit(0.5, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue'
                  )
```

```{r}
# for Loupe
#umap = cbind("Barcode" = rownames(Embeddings(object = dcSubReg, reduction = "umap")), Embeddings(object = dcSubReg, reduction = "umap"))
umap <- Embeddings(object = dcSubReg, reduction = "umap")
Idents(dcSubReg) <- 'genotype'

umap <- vector()
umap1 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'wt'), reduction = "umap")
umap2 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'ko'), reduction = "umap")
Idents(dcSubReg) <- 'HTO_maxID'
umap3 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'Hash1'), reduction = "umap")
umap4 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'Hash2'), reduction = "umap")
umap5 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'Hash3'), reduction = "umap")
umap6 <- Embeddings(object = subset(dcSubReg, idents = 'Hash5'), reduction = "umap")

library(wesanderson)
pal <- wes_palette("Zissou1", 100, type = "continuous")
#ayout(matrix(c(1,1,2,3), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE))
p1 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(umap3), aes(x=UMAP_1, y=UMAP_2) ) +
  geom_hex(bins = 36) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal,trans="log10", limits=c(-1,12), na.value="red3") +
  lims( x = c(-9, 11), y= c(-8,8)) +
  #scale_fill_continuous(type = 'viridis', trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red") + # 
  theme_bw() + NoLegend()
p2 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(umap4), aes(x=UMAP_1, y=UMAP_2) ) +
  geom_hex(bins = 36) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal,trans="log10", limits=c(-1,12), na.value="red3") +
  lims( x = c(-9, 11), y= c(-8,8)) +
  #scale_fill_continuous(type = 'viridis', trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red") + # 
  theme_bw()+ NoLegend()
p3 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(umap5), aes(x=UMAP_1, y=UMAP_2) ) +
  geom_hex(bins = 36) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal,trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red3") +
  lims( x = c(-9, 11), y= c(-8,8)) +
  #scale_fill_continuous(type = 'viridis', trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red") + # 
  theme_bw()+ NoLegend()
p4 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(umap6), aes(x=UMAP_1, y=UMAP_2) ) +
  geom_hex(bins = 36) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal,trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red3") +
  lims( x = c(-9, 11), y= c(-8,8)) +
  #scale_fill_continuous(type = 'viridis', trans="log10", limits=c(-1,16), na.value="red") + # 
  theme_bw()+ NoLegend()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, nrow = 1)

write.table(umap, file="~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/umap_rna.csv", sep = ",", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = T)
```

```{r}
new.cluster.ids <- c("pDC", "HSPC1", "cDC2", "monocytes", "HSPC4 (MDP)", "HSPC2 (Neutro)", "Neutrophil", "HSPC3 (Lymph)",  "cDC1","Mast cell")
new.cluster.ids <- c("pDC", "HSPC1", "cDC2", "monocyte", "HSPC2", "HSPC4", "Neutrophil", "HSPC3",  "cDC1","Mast")
Idents(dcSubReg) <- "seurat_clusters"
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dcSubReg)
dcSubReg <- RenameIdents(dcSubReg, new.cluster.ids)
DimPlot(dcSubReg, label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(dcSubReg, label = TRUE, split.by = 'HTO_maxID') + NoLegend()
```

```{r}
pseudotimePanel3 <- ggplot(subset(linTimeMelt, Day %in% c(3)), aes(Pseudotime, Geno, fill=Geno)) +
  geom_violin(fill=NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.2) +
  facet_grid(type_f~Day) +
  theme_classic() + theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.04, "cm"))

set_panel_size(pseudotimePanel3, f="~/scRNAseq/analysis/Plots/pseudotimePanel3.pdf", width = unit(4, "cm"), height = unit(0.97,"cm"))

degVolcano <- ggplot(SRclu1Mkr, aes(x=avg_logFC, y=-log10(p_val_adj), label=row.names(SRclu1Mkr))) + geom_point(size = 1) +
      geom_label_repel(data=  SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,], aes(label = row.names(SRclu1Mkr[log10(SRclu1Mkr$p_val_adj) < -30,])),
                      box.padding = unit(0.2, 'lines'),
                      label.padding = unit(0.1, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue',
                  size = 2.5,
                  )+
            theme_classic() +
```

```{r}
imbalancePlot <- ggplot(mdata,aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+geom_line(aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min1, ymax = max1), fill="#3399FF", alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(aes(x=t2,y=fit2))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min2, ymax = max2), fill="#CC6666", alpha=0.5)+
  theme_classic()


set_panel_size(imbalancePlot, f="~/scRNAseq/analysis/Plots/imbalancePlot_classic.pdf", width = unit(4, "cm"), height = unit(3,"cm"))
```
